responsibility_name: reduce energy waste from idle devices

evidence.evidence_text: When the power strip detects a state of inactivity equal to 1 hour, it sets its mode to off

coding.rationale: Power strip cuts power after 1h of inactivity; outcome is avoided idle energy draw, so grid_society benefits under a threshold condition.

responsibility_name: reduce energy waste in unused living room

evidence.evidence_text: IF NOT family in living room for more than 20 minutes, TURN OFF lights and tv and SHOW background image on tv

coding.rationale: Turns off lights/tv when family is absent from the living room; energy saving for society when the room is unoccupied.

responsibility_name: stop power draw once devices fully charged

evidence.evidence_text: When I charge the scooter and other electronic items, make sure that the outlet where the device is connected turns off once the items are 100% charged, in order to save energy.

coding.rationale: Outlet shuts off at 100% charge to save energy; avoids continued power draw, a threshold-triggered optimization.

responsibility_name: adjust room shading to daylight and occupancy

evidence.evidence_text: If there is light outside and if the person is inside the room, the roller shutter is lifted and the curtain is closed.

coding.rationale: Shading adjusts to daylight and presence inside the room to keep the resident comfortable while occupied.

responsibility_name: avoid lighting energy waste in empty entrance

evidence.evidence_text: When the entrance door closes and the user is not detected in the room, turn off the light in the entrance

coding.rationale: Entrance light turns off when no user is detected after the door closes; avoids lighting waste while unoccupied.

responsibility_name: Ensure blinds are closed during the night

evidence.evidence_text: If, between 10pm and 7am, the blinds are not closed, send a message to Alexa and set off an alarm

coding.rationale: Alerts when blinds are left open between 10pm and 7am; guards resident privacy/security at night.

responsibility_name: ensure lights are off when the house is empty

evidence.evidence_text: If there is no one at home, the light switches off and the shutters close.

coding.rationale: Lights switch off when no one is at home; guards against energy waste while the house is unoccupied.

responsibility_name: ensure shutters are closed when the house is empty

evidence.evidence_text: If there is no one at home, the light switches off and the shutters close.

coding.rationale: Shutters close when no one is at home; guards the property against intrusion while unoccupied.

responsibility_name: maintain adequate lighting for resident safety

evidence.evidence_text: The paper describes morning/evening lighting rules, motion-triggered lighting when the resident woke at night, and the resident's use of lighting for relaxation and reading.

coding.rationale: Motion-triggered lighting when the resident woke at night prevents falls/harm; maintained lighting for safety in darkness.

responsibility_name: maintain adequate lighting for resident comfort

evidence.evidence_text: The paper describes morning/evening lighting rules, motion-triggered lighting when the resident woke at night, and the resident's use of lighting for relaxation and reading.

coding.rationale: Lighting tailored to relaxation and reading supports resident comfort while occupying the space.

responsibility_name: Maintain comfortable lighting ambiance during music listening

evidence.evidence_text: While the user is listening to music DECREASE the brightness of the lights on in the lounge

coding.rationale: Dimming lights during music listening keeps ambiance comfortable for the resident while engaged in the activity.

responsibility_name: maintain working lighting by replacing failed bulbs

evidence.evidence_text: IF bulb NOT working, ORDER a new one on Amazon and ADD a reminder of estimated delivery date to your calendar.

coding.rationale: Reorders bulbs on failure so lighting does not run short; sustains working lighting for the resident.

responsibility_name: Provide illuminated, monitored entry when arriving home in the evening

evidence.evidence_text: When I enter the main gate, from 18.00 to 19.00, turn on the pedometers at the entrance and the lights on the veranda

coding.rationale: Lights turn on at the main gate during the 18:00-19:00 arrival window so the entry is lit when the resident arrives.

responsibility_name: save lighting energy when the kitchen is unoccupied

evidence.evidence_text: A person is not in the kitchen and therefore the light goes out and the alarm sensors come on.

coding.rationale: Kitchen light goes out when no one is present; saves lighting energy while the kitchen is unoccupied.
